Rep: Hi John, following up on our proposal for Global Cargo Corp.
Customer: We compared your quote with Competitor X. Competitor X is offering a cheaper price quote of 7L now.
Rep: What if we offer a modular phase 1 pilot with pre-built connectors?
Customer: That sounds interesting. We will discuss it in our executive committee meeting next week.
Rep Note: Customer agreed to discuss pilot, but outcome is currently pending. The salesperson thinks the phased rollout will probably win the deal.
